items: Remove caps pin and adjust placard
Put fuel selector to left tank
Turn on Nav and Strobe Lights
Verify voltage is between 23 and 25 volts
Check MFD date is not expired
Set fuel level in the MFD
Set weights and balance and press confirm
Listen to ATIS and take notes
Check left, center, right — announce clear prop
Set power lever to one quarter
Turn the key and push mixture to full rich
Verify volts is 28 and charging battery 1
Box check of flight controls and rudder
Release parking brake and turn landing light on
Start taxiing and check your brakes
Check HSI turns with aircraft with adequate rate of turn indicated
Verify turn coordinator turns with rudder movement
Verify magnetic compass agrees with HSI
Verify zero airspeed and zero vertical speed
Verify attitude indicator is no more than 5 degrees
Set parking brake and turn landing light off
Announce alternator check and turn landing light and pitot heat on
Check and announce voltage in green
Turn pitot heat and landing light off
Set power lever full — announce max RPM, should be more than 2600
Power lever to idle — announce idle power, minimum 700 RPM
Verify climb power lever is full
Verify and announce engine is in the green
Clean flaps above 85 knots and 200 feet AGL
Set climb speed to Vy, 105 knots
Continue to adjust mixture to stay at the top of the green arc
Level off and allow aircraft to accelerate to 120 knots
Lean mixture to the cyan line
Perform arrival briefing with landing plates
Turn landing lights and ice lights on
Check brake pressure and ask passenger to check theirs
